additional_requirements.title: Ensure deployments are automated
additional_requirements.text: Automate each deployment process of the production environment and application.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure the deployment environment is reproducible
additional_requirements.text: Adjust the process that deploys the deployment/production environment to build the same environment each time when the configuration has not changed.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure access to production environment is limited
additional_requirements.text: Restrict access to the production environment to trusted and qualified users.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure default passwords are not used
additional_requirements.text: For each deployment tool, change the password.
